svg.title: Four measures over 31 complete project weeks: work commits, models and checks, recovered dispatches, and documented Epic completions.
svg.desc: Four measures over 31 complete project weeks: work commits, models and checks, recovered dispatches, and documented Epic completions. Early shading denotes missing records, not zero activity. Counts do not measure productivity.
